text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages, each with eight quote variants, for testing a citation checker.

passages.source_passage: During 2023, the Lakemere District Health Programme supported 212 community health workers across 38 villages. Each worker made an average of twelve household visits per month, and 84% of children under five were screened for malnutrition at least once. The programme did not reach the three highland wards of Kiruma, because the bridge at Nyabo was closed from March until August. Supervisors visited every cluster each quarter. No stock-outs of oral rehydration salts were recorded after June, which the team credits to the new monthly reorder system.

variants.whitespace_case: THE PROGRAMME DID NOT REACH the three highland wards of Kiruma,  because the bridge at Nyabo was closed from March until August.
variants.punctuation: Each worker made an average of twelve household visits per month and 84% of children under five were screened for malnutrition at least once
variants.changed_quantity: During 2023, the Lakemere District Health Programme supported 212 community health workers across 54 villages.
variants.added_negation: Each worker made an average of twelve household visits per month, and 84% of children under five were not screened for malnutrition at least once.
variants.removed_negation: The programme did reach the three highland wards of Kiruma, because the bridge at Nyabo was closed from March until August.
variants.reordered: The programme did not reach the three highland wards of Kiruma, because the bridge at Nyabo was closed from August until March.
variants.paraphrase: The three highland wards of Kiruma were left out of the programme because the Nyabo bridge was shut between March and August.

passages.source_passage: At the mid-term point in 2022, the Tumaini Village Savings and Loan Programme had formed 146 groups with a combined membership of 3,430 people, 71% of them women. Average savings per member reached the equivalent of 48 dollars, up from 19 dollars at baseline. The evaluators found that most groups repaid loans on time, but not every group kept written records. No group in Ndoro district had received refresher training since the launch. Field officers say that the second cycle will begin in January 2024.

passages.source_passage: In 2023 the Kasanda Camp Case Management Service opened 1,205 new files for refugees at risk, including 318 unaccompanied children. Caseworkers met every client within five working days in 90% of cases. The service could not offer interpreters for Tigrinya until October, and many women told us they did not feel safe sharing details in shared tents. We therefore built two private interview rooms in the second half of the year. A referral to the district hospital was never delayed for lack of transport.

passages.source_passage: The Mwanza Hills Home Visiting Programme supported 460 clients living with HIV during the 2022 reporting year, visiting each at least once every fortnight. Of these, 87% were taking antiretroviral treatment by December. Volunteers did not hand out medicines themselves; they reminded clients about clinic appointments and carried results back to nurses. Eleven clients were lost to follow-up after moving to the mining towns, and the programme has no way of tracking them across the border. Next year we plan to add 25 volunteers.

passages.source_passage: In the Sendeke region, an estimated one in five adults live with anxiety or depression, yet there are only four trained counsellors for a population of roughly 310,000. Since opening in 2019, the Open Door Community Counselling Service has held over 9,000 sessions in church halls and clinics. A 2021 survey showed that most clients waited less than two weeks for a first appointment. However, the service does not currently reach men aged 18 to 30, who made up just 6% of clients. This proposal seeks funding to address that gap.

passages.source_passage: Trainer's note: In this session, volunteers learn the three steps of a first client interview. First, greet the client and explain that you are a paralegal, not a lawyer. Second, listen for at least ten minutes without interrupting. Third, write down the dates, names and documents the client mentions. Never promise a result, and do not give advice about court strategy. Allow 45 minutes for the role-play, and do not skip the debrief, which takes about 15 minutes. Participants should keep the checklist on page 4 of their handbook.

passages.source_passage: Welcome to the Harbourside Vocational Training Centre. Over the 2024 intake, 120 young people aged 16 to 24 will join one of five trades. As a volunteer mentor, you will not teach technical skills; the instructors do that. Your role is to help trainees practise interviews and write short CVs. Attendance below 80% is a warning sign, so please tell the coordinator early. Nobody should be pressed to disclose family problems, and no trainee needs to share a phone number with you. Mentoring sessions last 30 minutes and run every Thursday.

passages.source_passage: In the northern savannah districts of Karanda, only 41% of primary-school pupils eat a meal before lunchtime, and teachers report that hunger is the most common reason children leave class early. The Bright Start School Nutrition Programme has served a daily meal of millet porridge and beans to 14,000 pupils in 62 schools since 2020. Independent monitoring found no rise in enrolment among girls in the first year, but attendance improved by eight percentage points. Cooks are paid by the community, not by the programme. We now seek support to extend the model to 40 further schools.

passages.source_passage: Between January and December 2023, the Riverbend Family Tracing and Foster Care Service placed 73 separated children in foster families and reunited 41 children with relatives. Every foster household was visited within the first 14 days, and no child was placed without a background check. Unfortunately, we were unable to trace the families of 19 children, who remain in interim care. Funding for the training of foster parents did not arrive on time, so the second training round was postponed to early 2024. Foster parents received a monthly stipend of 60 dollars.

passages.source_passage: The Open Paths Assistive Devices and Accessibility Project, now halfway through its five-year term, has distributed 1,870 wheelchairs, hearing aids and white canes since 2021. Evaluators found that 78% of recipients were using their devices daily, although fewer than half had received any repair training. Three of the eleven partner schools have not yet installed ramps, and the project has not met its target of 25 accessible clinics. Beneficiaries praised the home-fitting service, which was free of charge. The evaluators recommend that the budget for spare parts be doubled.
